SELECT * FROM activation_purchases WHERE user_id=#{user} AND request_key=#{key}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO membership_redemption_codes(id,code_hash,code_suffix,label,duration_days,expires_at,bound_user_id) VALUES(#{id},#{hash},#{suffix},'模拟购买 · 7 天体验会员',7,#{expires},#{user})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM activation_purchases WHERE status='paid' AND delivery_status IN ('pending','failed') AND sealed_code IS NOT NULL AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND attempts < 5 AND code_expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE activation_purchases SET sealed_code=NULL,delivery_status='expired' WHERE id=#{id} AND code_expires_at <=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND sealed_code IS NOT NULL
